chunks.title: Profile
chunks.text: Mayur Dokras is a GenAI Engineer and Backend Engineer with 4+ years of industry experience across telecom (Capgemini Engineering), a UK cyber-security startup (Malvox) and FinTech (freelance). He holds an MSc in Software Engineering from the University of Southampton, UK. He builds AI end to end: data pipelines, vector stores, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LoRA fine-tuned models and small language models, served behind secure Python APIs. At Capgemini he worked as a Software Engineer on Python tool development, debugging and production support.

chunks.title: Profile
chunks.text: Mayur is looking for GenAI Engineer, MLOps Engineer, AI Engineer, Applied AI Engineer and Backend / Python Engineer roles. He is not targeting frontend-only roles, Java-first backend roles or pure data-migration roles.

chunks.title: Profile
chunks.text: Mayur is currently based in Pune, India. He is open to roles in the UK, Europe (including Sweden, Lithuania and Luxembourg), the US, New Zealand, Turkey and India, and is happy to relocate. He is an immediate joiner with no notice period, as he has no current employer.

chunks.title: Profile
chunks.text: For long-term employment in the UK, Mayur would require visa sponsorship.

chunks.title: Profile
chunks.text: Mayur works well in international, research-driven teams. At Malvox he worked closely with PhD researchers and colleagues from several countries. At Capgemini he coordinated 4 to 5 engineers across development, debugging, code reviews and releases. He describes his strengths as ownership, problem solving, technical mentoring and team collaboration.

chunks.title: Experience
chunks.text:
Part-time Backend Engineer at Malvox, an early-stage UK cyber-security startup connected to the University of Southampton.
- Integrated 3 UK Government APIs using Python, SQL and REST APIs for secure backend workflows, with GDPR compliance.
- Designed relational data models and secure data flows using OAuth2, HTTPS/TLS and AES-256 encryption.
- Implemented authentication, authorisation and rate limiting.
- Services were deployed on Kubernetes.
- Debugged API, authentication, database and integration issues across real-time workflows.
- Developed a browser plugin and maintained the CI/CD pipeline.
- Worked alongside PhD researchers in an international, multicultural team using Agile, Git and CI/CD.
- The Malvox website was built in React, so he also worked with React there.

chunks.title: Experience
chunks.section: Capgemini Engineering: Software Engineer (Nov 2021 to Nov 2024)
chunks.text:
Three years as a full-time Software Engineer (grade Associate II), focused on Python tool development, debugging and production support for global telecom clients.
- Built 5 Python automation tools for debugging, log analysis and operational workflows, reducing manual engineering effort.
- Debugged and supported production systems on Linux, working with Python and C/C++ code.
- Performed root-cause analysis with GDB, Wireshark and system logs, contributing to a 25% reduction in mean time to resolution (MTTR).
- Provided production support: resolved 40+ production defects and delivered 7+ production features across global client environments.
- Coordinated 4 to 5 engineers across development, debugging, code reviews and release activities.
- Worked with Jenkins CI/CD, GitHub and Agile/Scrum.

chunks.title: GenAI Projects
chunks.section: Small Language Model with voice (founder project, in stealth)
chunks.text: Mayur is building his own product: a small language model (SLM) with voice integration, for his own website and an Android application, running on free and open-source infrastructure. It has not launched yet and work is ongoing. The domain and training data are confidential until launch, so MACK cannot share details about what it is trained on.

chunks.title: GenAI Projects
chunks.text: SotonBuddy is a University of Southampton campus chatbot that Mayur built with classmates. It gives students walking directions to campus buildings and answers university questions. The model was fine-tuned with LoRA (low-rank adaptation) on question-and-answer pairs created from University of Southampton website documents, using Hugging Face and PyTorch. It was built as an MSc coursework project and trialled with a test batch on a free student workspace, where 68 of the 83 students in his MSc class tried it. It is not a public product.

chunks.title: GenAI Projects
chunks.text: An AI-powered platform for intelligent assistants, LLM integration and workflow automation. Backend services are built with Python and FastAPI, using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over a Chroma vector store, OpenAI APIs and secure REST APIs, designed for production-ready AI applications and agentic workflows.

chunks.title: GenAI Projects
chunks.text: MACK is the assistant on Mayur's portfolio. It uses Google Gemini 2.5 Flash behind a Vercel serverless API, with hybrid retrieval (vector embeddings plus BM25 keyword search) over a knowledge base. A GitHub Actions pipeline rebuilds the knowledge base and embeddings whenever the knowledge files change and every week, pulls in Mayur's public GitHub repositories, and runs an automated evaluation suite that fails the build if answer quality regresses. MACK streams answers token by token, cites its sources, keeps multi-turn context, supports voice input, and can score a pasted job description against Mayur's profile.

chunks.title: GenAI Projects
chunks.text: Job Octo is Mayur's job board, still in development and not launched yet. It auto-fetches roles matching a profile, shows a skills-match percentage on every job card, and tracks applications from Applied to Accepted or Rejected. He plans to open it to friends and launch it publicly with worldwide coverage of FinTechs and MNCs.

chunks.title: GenAI Projects
chunks.text: Mayur follows CI/CD practices for deploying LLM applications: versioned knowledge and prompts, automated evaluation before release, and continuous improvement of answers through retrieval context and prompt engineering. He has experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions and Jenkins pipelines.

chunks.title: Other Projects
chunks.text: Full-stack Android app built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and Material Design 3. It integrates UK Government APIs (Charity Commission and the Food Hygiene Rating Scheme) for verification, uses a Firebase backend with geolocation filtering, and implements a fair-allocation algorithm for distributing food donations.

chunks.title: Other Projects
chunks.text: Mayur has built mobile apps with Flutter/Dart, Kotlin/Jetpack Compose and Swift. Projects include MackFit (a Flutter workout app with Firebase hosting and JSON local storage), an Ed-Tech app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Material 3, with a Next.js and Firebase web companion), e-commerce, grocery and fitness apps, and an iOS app in Swift with a shared Firebase backend.

chunks.title: Other Projects
chunks.text: An image-processing web application using JavaScript, PHP, MySQL and HTML/CSS. It used hash-map based algorithms to optimise performance and analysed search-engine limitations using PageRank methodology. Mayur published a research paper on image processing based on topic diversity from this work.

chunks.title: Other Projects
chunks.text: Diploma project: a steganography system in Java using the least-significant-bit (LSB) algorithm.
